description: Routing and navigation: register the three new planner routes in App.jsx, update BottomNav to add a Planner entry, and update the AppShell desktop nav links. Depends on FEAT-002 pages existing. Independent from FEAT-001 for ordering purposes but must run after FEAT-002.
steps: Update src/App.jsx: add three imports at the top — import Planner from './pages/Planner'; import PlannerTerm from './pages/PlannerTerm'; import PlannerSubject from './pages/PlannerSubject'. Inside the <AppShell> Route block, add after the /curriculum route: <Route path="/planner" element={<Planner />} />, <Route path="/planner/:termId" element={<PlannerTerm />} />, <Route path="/planner/:termId/:subjectId" element={<PlannerSubject />} />.

Update src/components/layout/BottomNav.jsx: add CalendarDays to the lucide-react import. Change the items array entry { to: '/course', label: 'Course', icon: BookOpen } to { to: '/planner', label: 'Planner', icon: CalendarDays }. Remove BookOpen from the import if it is no longer referenced elsewhere in the file.

Update src/components/layout/AppShell.jsx: in the links array, change { to: '/course', label: 'Course' } to { to: '/planner', label: 'Planner' }. The /course route remains in App.jsx but is removed from the prominent nav.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero errors
App.jsx imports and registers all three /planner routes
BottomNav shows 'Planner' with CalendarDays icon on mobile (5-column grid still intact)
AppShell desktop nav includes 'Planner' link pointing to /planner
